'''''Fate of the Jedi: Ascension''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel and the penultimate volume in the nine-part ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' series. It was written by [[Christie Golden]] and first published by [[Del Rey]] in hardcover on [[August 9]], [[2011]]. The first paperback edition was released on [[November 27]], [[2012]].
